_comment: Per-runway config for the Service Performance dashboard (service-performance.html + api/service-performance/). Uses GRAFANA_BASIC_USER/PASS from .env for cross-org basic auth (single credential works for org=2 EKS Thanos + org=3 ACM). labelScheme picks the PromQL family: 'k8s' = kube-state-metrics (namespace/deployment/pod), 'appScope' = ACM's up{env_name,appScope} exporter labels. Managed via api/service-performance/sources.php (admin+SM only).

sources._comment: Disabled 2026-08-03. Investigation showed acm-* services (e.g. acm-irs-core-service) actually live on cluster=acm-tmn-eks-prod in truemoney-*-production namespaces — already covered by EKS TMN source. The appScope scheme queried up{env_name=prod,appScope=~acm-.*} which returns zero series, so it never worked. Kept here (enabled=false) so history is visible; remove after review.
sources.name: ACM

sources._jvmComment: jvmDsUid points at the separate `Thanos OnPrem` datasource that scrapes application /actuator/prometheus (Micrometer JVM metrics). Optional — when set, detail.php pulls jvm_memory_used_bytes + jvm_memory_max_bytes and the UI renders a JVM Heap gauge alongside the container-mem view. Java services expose these; non-Java services return empty and the gauge is auto-hidden.
sources.name: OCP TH

_serviceInventoryComment: Canonical path (SM-shared) — replaced via admin/service-inventory.html upload. Previous versions live under data/sm/service-inventory-history/. Full column set powers the metadata card in the service-performance detail view.
